rows.en: We will now go up into space and continue the pursuit mission.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: To keep things safe in orbit, <pt(0,-25,0,0)>we'll first launch an advance team by <pic(0)><cs(3)>shuttle<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: The launch is meant to be secret, but given the enemy forces' recent movements,
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: we had better assume an attack is quite likely.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: In an emergency, coordinate with the Gran Garan and protect the shuttle.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Good work on the mission. We will now set course for the Moon.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: But spurred by events on the ground, every faction in space has grown more active too.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: White Fang and Giganos, who both obtained E2s, are sure to make their move as well.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: So urgent missions are likely to come up. I want you to stay sharp.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: You are the UCE's last hope. I want you to understand that and act accordingly.
